articles.title: Bitcoin tumbles to new multi-year low of $58,000, but a short-squeeze setup emerges
articles.snippet: Derivatives markets signal that betting on further slide in prices is getting overcrowded, setting up for a potential snapback.

articles.title: Iran-linked entities moved $3.8B through CoinEx, TRM says
articles.snippet: TRM Labs traced $3.8 billion moved by 60 sanctioned Iranian entities through CoinEx and said that the exchange’s 8% share of illicit transactions was substantially higher than its counterparts.

articles.title: House Democrats seek SEC answers on AI investment advisers
articles.snippet: House Democrats have questioned the SEC over trading platforms offering AI agent advisers making “consequential investment decisions on behalf of retail investors.”

articles.title: Mark Zuckerberg Wants a Prediction Market Too: NYT
articles.snippet: The initiative follows bets on stablecoins and the metaverse.
